info.title: Luna API
info.description:
Luna is a baby tracker for feeds, sleep, nappies, solids and routines, shared between parents and invited caregivers.

This REST API is the same one the Luna web app uses. Every request is scoped to **one family**: the family is resolved from the bearer token (or session cookie) and there is no way to address another family's data.

## Authentication

* **Bearer token** (`Authorization: Bearer <token>`) — the way agents and scripts should call the API. Create one in the app (Settings → Connect an assistant) or `POST /api/vega/token` from a signed-in session. Tokens are stored hashed and can carry `read` or `read`+`write` scopes.
* **Session cookie** (`luna_session`) — what the browser uses after `POST /login` or `POST /api/vega/onboard`.

Only `GET /api/health` and `POST /api/vega/onboard` are reachable without credentials. Unauthenticated calls to anything else return `401 {"error": "unauthorized"}`.

## Conventions

* Timestamps are ISO 8601 in the family's local time (`YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS`); omit `ts` to log "now". Future timestamps are rejected.
* Volumes are millilitres, weights kilograms, lengths centimetres. Families with `units: imperial` still store metric.
* Errors are JSON `{"error": "<code or message>"}` with a 4xx status.
* Luna is not a medical device: nothing here diagnoses, assesses symptoms or advises on medication.

## Other ways in

* **MCP connector** at `https://getmyluna.app/mcp` (streamable HTTP, same bearer token) — 23 tools, resources and prompts for Meta Muse, Claude Code and any MCP client. Manifest: `/.well-known/luna-connector.json`.
* **Agent instructions**: `/llms.txt`. **Developer portal**: `/developers`. **CLI**: `/cli/luna.py`.

get.description: When to use Luna and how to call it, in the llms.txt format. Also at `/.well-known/agent-instructions.md`.

post.description: Allowlisted event names only; no PII. Public so the marketing pages can call it.
Public sign-up: creates a new family (tenant) and its first admin caregiver, and sets a session cookie. Every later call is scoped to this family. Returns `409` if the email is already registered.

get.description: Always `{"ok": true}` when the app is serving. No auth.
The username, family id and role the current credentials resolve to. Useful for confirming a bearer token works.

post.description: Sets the name the family sees for you (away card, timeline, partner list, connector). Refuses email addresses. `400` if empty or over 40 characters.

post.summary: Record that Luna is on your home screen
post.description: Ticks 'Add Luna to your home screen' on the Getting started checklist for this caregiver, on every device.

get.description: Whether this caregiver has agreed to the current health-data and Ask Luna (AI) wording, with version and time.

post.description: `{kind: health|ai, agree: true|false}`. Agreeing records the current wording version and time; `false` withdraws it (for `ai`, Ask Luna stops sending anything to the AI provider).

get.description: Admin only. Aggregate, non-PII sign-up and activity counts.
Admin only. Everything the family has logged as one JSON document (served as a download). Excludes password and token hashes.

post.description: Append a feed, sleep/wake, nappy, solid meal, note, supplement or measurement. Validates ranges (milk 0–500 ml, weight 0.5–30 kg, length 40–120 cm) and rejects future timestamps. Returns the saved event, the refreshed live status, and a soft `warning` if the time conflicts with a recorded sleep span.

get.description: Foods logged in the last 14 days, most recent first — handy for autocomplete.

Remove one event by id.
Add an emoji reaction from the current caregiver to an event.
Store a named ingredient list so it can be logged as one solid meal.
Removes the most recently logged event. Returns `removed: null` when the log is empty.

get.description: Asleep/awake, hunger state, next feed estimate, last nappy, today's totals and any alert — derived from the log right now. `checklist` is the Getting started state from the server: `first_log`, `partner_joined`, `invite_sent`, `installed`.

post.description: Stores this user's last-seen timestamp so the While you were away card can clear.

get.description: Always `{}` for public families; kept for compatibility with older clients.
Sleep patterns, 14-day totals, today's events, and — once solids have started — 7-day nutrient tallies, targets and the allergen grid.
All events for `date` (YYYY-MM-DD), oldest first. Defaults to today.

schema.description: Day to list, YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to today (family-local).

get.description: All logged weight and length events, oldest first.
Name, date of birth, computed age, region, units, timezone and member count.

post.description: Admin only. Any subset of fields; setting `region` also sets `units` unless given.

Mints a token for agents, scripts or the MCP connector. The plaintext is returned **once**. Re-minting with the same `label` replaces that token; different labels coexist. Optional body — omit it for a full-access token labelled with your username.

get.description: Every token issued for this family (never the secret).

post.description: Immediately stops that token (and any assistant using it).

get.summary: List family members and open invites
get.description: Caregivers in this family. Open invite links are included for admins only.

delete.description: Admin only. Deletes the family, every event, note, token, invite and connector state. Cannot be undone; `confirm` must match the family's name exactly.

post.description: Admin only. What the Settings button calls: `confirm` is the family name or `DELETE`, plus the admin's password. Same deletion as `DELETE /api/vega/family`, then the session is cleared. `403 wrong_password`; `429 rate_limited` after repeated wrong passwords.
For caregivers who aren't the admin: deletes your own login, your API tokens and consent records; the family's log stays. Requires your password. The admin gets `403 admin_cannot_leave`.
Admin only. A 48-hour invite link a partner, grandparent or nanny uses at `/join` to get their own login for this family.
Admin only. Invalidates an unused invite code.

A question answered from this family's own log, in Luna's non-clinical lane. Requires Luna Plus (`402 payment_required` otherwise) and is subject to daily/monthly limits (`429 usage_limit_reached`). Prefix the question with `remember:` to save a note instead.

403.description: One-time Ask Luna AI opt-in needed first (`ai_consent_required`); see `POST /api/consent`

get.description: Durable notes saved for this family.

post.description: Delete one remembered note by its `ts`.
